slides.title: "Did my assignment even upload?" Now you'll actually know.
1. Open your course, tap Assignments
slides.caption: Every assignment with its due date and points, in one list.

slides.title: Submit online. See "Submitted".
slides.body: Upload from your phone or laptop and the status flips to Submitted. No more "sir, did you get my mail?"

slides.title: A reminder 24 hours before
slides.body: A nudge a day before the deadline. Not 24 minutes after, from the batch group.

slides.title: Feedback, not just a number
slides.body: When your teacher releases grades, the feedback comes with it. Know what to fix before internals.

slides.title: Graduating? Your work stays
slides.body: Convocation done, but your past assignments and grades are still yours to look back on.

slides.title: Want this on your campus? Tag your college
slides.body: 30-day free trial for colleges, no card needed.
